serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Gotta clear my mind a bit.
Lots of things keep happening and these walks are the best thing I came up with to deal with them.
It’s weirdly silent around here and there’s less people than usual, even at this hour.
{gv_Hour}, huh. This street should be full, well, maybe not full, but some people should be coming back from parties and stuff.
